seo.title: Kitchen Display System for Restaurants | RestaBee
seo.description: Kitchen display system for restaurant teams: route tickets by station, track item preparation and mark ready quantities. Explore RestaBee KDS.

copy.heroDescription: RestaBee’s kitchen display system for restaurant teams routes order items to assigned stations, where staff can start preparation, update ready quantities and acknowledge changes.
copy.workflowTitle: From new ticket to ready quantity
copy.workflowDescription: Kitchen display systems give the team a shared view of what is waiting, what is being prepared and what is ready to leave the station.
copy.stationTitle: Send each item to its preparation station
copy.stationDescription: Orders are split into kitchen tickets according to the stations assigned to their menu items. Filter the queue to the stations assigned to a staff member, or review all assigned stations together.
copy.ticketDetailsTitle: Keep the details with the ticket
copy.ticketDetailsDescription: A restaurant kitchen display system keeps service context beside each item, so the kitchen can check what to prepare and where it belongs.
copy.quantityTitle: Mark what is ready, including part of an order
copy.quantityDescription: Staff can start an item, mark the full quantity ready or record a partial ready quantity. The remaining amount stays visible until preparation is complete.
copy.changesTitle: Make order changes visible to the kitchen
copy.changesDescription: When an order is amended or an item is cancelled after it reaches the kitchen, the change appears for acknowledgement. Staff review it before continuing work on that ticket.
copy.printTitle: Kitchen display software that works with the print queue
copy.printDescription: The screen shows changing ticket status and station filters. RestaBee also includes a print queue for kitchens that use paper tickets. Choose the workflow that fits the station and its setup.
copy.faqDescription: Answers about station assignment, ready quantities, order changes and printed tickets.
copy.ctaTitle: See RestaBee in your kitchen workflow
copy.ctaDescription: Review kitchen stations, ticket progress and the handoff from order entry in a guided product demo.

faqs.question: What does a kitchen display system do?
faqs.answer: A kitchen display system places incoming order items in a digital kitchen queue. Staff can view the assigned station, start preparation and update item readiness.

faqs.question: Can a kitchen display system for restaurant teams route tickets by station?
faqs.answer: Yes. Menu items can be assigned to preparation stations. The kitchen queue can show all assigned stations or be filtered to a specific station.

faqs.question: Can staff mark only part of an item quantity ready?
faqs.answer: Yes. Staff can record a partial ready quantity. The remaining quantity stays on the ticket until it is ready.

faqs.question: Can we keep printed kitchen tickets?
faqs.answer: Yes. RestaBee includes a print queue alongside its kitchen display software. Printer setup depends on the chosen device and station configuration.

faqs.question: What happens when an order changes after it is sent?
faqs.answer: The kitchen ticket marks the amendment or cancellation for acknowledgement. Staff can review the change before continuing with the ticket.

faqs.question: Does POS with kitchen display support item notes?
faqs.answer: Kitchen tickets show item choices and notes entered with the order, alongside its station and quantity details.
